head.t: ZOLL wins London Ambulance Service defibrillator monitor contract worth £27.3m
head.x: London Ambulance Service NHS Trust has awarded ZOLL Medical UK a contract for core defibrillator monitors and critical care monitors, including installation, training, servicing and maintenance.

head.t: ZOLL wins direct-award defibrillator contract at new Velindre Cancer Centre
head.x: Velindre University NHS Trust has awarded a direct contract worth £111,214 to ZOLL Medical UK Limited for defibrillators and accessories at the New Velindre Cancer Centre, concluded 15 October 2026 and published on Find a Tender on 30 October 2026.

head.t: Framework ending 29 October 2027: Medical Chart Paper and Ultrasound Film

head.t: Framework ending 28 September 2027: Non Invasive Ventilation, Sleep Therapy, CPAP and Sleep Monitoring Diagnostics
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "ZOLL Medical UK Ltd". 28 suppliers on the framework.
